title: Temporal Rift
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji made his decision, a deafening dragon's roar echoed from the depths of the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. The temporal rift began expanding violently, visible to the naked eye, as if some ancient beast was trying to tear apart this world.

text.content: When the final formation eye fell into place, Chen Ji suddenly sensed an异样 pulse from the ground beneath his feet—not the aura of a dragon's vein, but a massive rift spanning through time and space, as if something was gazing at him from the depths of the crack. He instinctively retreated half a step, his fingertips unconsciously rubbing the warm formation eye stone in his sleeve. The soil beneath his feet began to crack, delicate patterns spreading like a spider's web in all directions. Each fissure glowed with a ghostly blue light—the distinctive color of temporal chaos. A low rumble echoed from the distance, like an ancient beast awakening in the abyss.

dialogue.content: "Steady your mind, that is not an enemy." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice rang in his thoughts, carrying rare solemnity. "This is a Heavenly Secrets Rift—an异象 that only appears when a temporal node is triggered. It seems our arrangements have touched a causal thread that should never have been disturbed."

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the churning unease in his heart, his gaze firmly fixed on the expanding rift. The ghostly blue light grew increasingly intense, and he could even see flowing fragments of stars within it—materialized temporal chaos. Suddenly, a figure coalesced in the depths of the rift, as blurred as a reflection in water, yet radiating a chilling pressure. It was not a physical entity, but some kind of projection crossing through time and space, every contour warped by rules that did not belong to this world.

dialogue.content: "Who?" Chen Ji asked in a low voice, his right hand already secretly gripping the talisman in his sleeve. The jade slip hidden in his sleeve of heavens, inscribed with three of his trump cards, was warming slightly, ready to activate protective spiritual light at any moment. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, but this time carrying a rare惊疑 Chen Ji had never heard before: "This aura... impossible, he should have dissipated long ago!"

text.content: In the depths of the rift, the blurred figure slowly spoke, its voice seeming to come from an extremely distant place, each word carrying the沧桑 of crossing through time and space: "Chen Ji, the feigned death scheme has more than one participant." These six words exploded like thunder beside Chen Ji's ear. His pupils constricted sharply. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace trembled violently, its surface covered in dense cracks—the precursor of Heavenly Fate being forcibly extracted. He forcefully suppressed the churning Tianji Record, his gaze sharp as a blade piercing toward that figure.

dialogue.content: "Impossible!" Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rose, and in his loss of composure, it even carried a trembling: "During that battle, I personally witnessed him being destroyed both physically and spiritually, with no chance of rebirth! Chen Ji, this person is lying!"

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond to Mo Xiansheng but stared fixedly at the figure in the rift. The cracks in the Tianji Record continued spreading, but he did not stop them—if what the other party said was true, then this little consumption of Heavenly Fate was completely worthwhile. He forced his voice to remain calm: "You said the feigned death scheme has more than one person—what do you mean? Who is the other one executing a feigned death?" The figure in the rift seemed to smile, that smile distorted enough to send chills down one's spine: "Your enemies, your elders, perhaps... also those you believed to be already dead."

choice.prompt: The existence within the temporal rift dropped a shocking piece of information—feigned death scheme, more than one person. Chen Ji had to quickly make a judgment: immediately pursue the truth, or maintain vigilance and first verify the other party's identity?

choices.description: "At the cost of consuming more Heavenly Fate, forcibly activate the Tianji Record to inquire about the other party's true identity and the details of the feigned death plan. Although the risk is extreme, information is life and death."
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information: confirm the possible identity of the second feigned death practitioner
choices.risk_hint: May encounter an information trap set by the other party, leading to misjudgment

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. With a single thought, the Tianji Record Fragment unfurled violently in his embrace. Golden text slithered across its surface like swimming snakes, and he felt his Heavenly Fate pouring out like a tide. Meanwhile, the figure in the rift also began to grow clearer, a face that made his scalp go numb gradually emerging—it was a person who should have been dead, a person he had never expected to appear again.

dialogue.content: "Chen Tianming?!" Chen Ji blurted out this name, his voice carrying难以掩饰的shocked. His mind raced at lightning speed, countless thoughts colliding together—if Chen Tianming was still alive, how much of what Mo Xiansheng said back then was true? Should the mystery of his own origins be re-examined? The figure in the rift slowly nodded: "It seems you still remember me. Little Ji, when your father passed the Tianji Record to you, I had already set this move in place."

choices.description: "Do not easily believe what the other party says, use words to probe the other party's flaws. The real Chen Tianming would not appear in such a way—the temporal rift itself is the biggest point of doubt."
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information through probing, judge the other party's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: May anger the other party, leading to interrupted information

text.content: Chen Ji sneered coldly, retreating instead of advancing, putting a step of distance between himself and the rift. His gaze was terrifyingly calm: "Interesting. Using a temporal rift to deliver information, speaking in Chen Tianming's name—if it were really him, why resort to this method?" The moment his words fell, the figure in the rift violently fluctuated, and a hint of错愕 appeared on that blurred face, then transformed into appreciation.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji continued pressing: "Temporal rifts only open for two types of existence—Heavenly Dao's will, or those chosen by Heavenly Dao. Which one are you?" The figure in the rift fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a low laugh: "Good lad, you truly haven't disappointed me. Very well, I am neither Chen Tianming nor any Heavenly Dao's will. I am merely... another person chosen by the Tianji Record."

text.content: "A person also chosen by the Tianji Record"—these words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. He下意识地 looked at the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace, those healing cracks seeming to silently speak of something. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, this time carrying deep exhaustion: "The last person to possess the complete Tianji Record was Chen Xuan. And before that... there were seven others. Every single one did not survive past thirty years old." Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill rise from his spine.

dialogue.content: The being in the rift seemed to hear Mo Xiansheng's words, its voice carrying a hint of sorrow: "So you understand now? The Tianji Record is not a blessing, but a curse. Every holder is a chess piece of the Heavenly Dao, used and discarded. Chen Xuan discovered this truth back then, so he chose another path—faking his death to escape, passing the Tianji Record to the next generation while hiding in the shadows, waiting for his chance." Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly: "Wait, are you saying Chen Xuan—my ancestor—is still alive?"

choice.prompt: The mysterious being revealed a shocking secret: the fake death scheme involves more than one person, Chen Xuan may still be alive, and Mo Xiansheng's identity is also questionable. Chen Ji faces a crucial choice: to pursue further questioning, or to stabilize the situation first?

choices.text: Questioning Mo Xiansheng about the truth
choices.description: If Chen Xuan is still alive, what has Mo Xiansheng been hiding all these years? Whose side is he really on? Chen Ji decides to confront Mo Xiansheng directly, even if he is his nominal master.
choices.visible_reward: Force out Mo Xiansheng's true attitude, determine his stance
choices.risk_hint: May destabilize one's own faction, weakening support

text.content: Chen Ji did not ask aloud, but directly transmitted his voice to Mo Xiansheng through his spiritual sense: "Mo Xiansheng, how much do you know about Chen Xuan still being alive?" Silence filled the spiritual sense, lasting a full ten breaths. Only then did Mo Xiansheng's voice arrive belatedly, carrying a trace of bitterness: "Little friend, some things, the more you know, the faster you die."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sneered in his heart: "Knowing too much kills you faster? Then all these years of guiding me through the maze—were you helping me or harming me?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then suddenly sighed: "Forget it. Since you've already grown suspicious, further concealment would be pointless. Chen Xuan is indeed still alive, but he is trapped somewhere he cannot escape from. As for me... I am merely a remnant soul, without any stance of my own. I only serve the Tianji Record."

choices.text: Inquire about the timing of the fake death
choices.description: Regardless of whether Chen Xuan is alive or dead, the most important thing now is to determine the variables in the fake death plan. Chen Ji decides to first inquire about key information regarding this fake death scheme, prioritizing solving the immediate predicament.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the timing of the fake death, gain the initiative
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity to expose the truth of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his doubts in his heart, his gaze falling once more on the figure in the rift: "You said the fake death scheme involves more than one person, and that the Dragon Vein awakening will trigger a massive outbreak of spatiotemporal rifts—what does this mean? How should I use this?" The figure in the rift nodded approvingly: "Good question. At the moment of the Dragon Vein awakening, temporal rules will briefly fall into chaos, and all divination techniques will be rendered ineffective for three days. If you wish to fake death, that is the only moment when you can evade the surveillance of the Heavenly Dao's Eye."

dialogue.content: "Three days..." Chen Ji murmured, his eyes growing increasingly bright. He quickly ran through calculations in his mind—three days was enough time to complete all preparations for the fake death, and enough to reposition himself amid the chaos. But the figure in the rift turned sharply: "But the problem is, someone else has thought of this too. In other words, at the moment of the Dragon Vein awakening, you will not be the only one faking death."

text.content: "More than one person faking death—" Chen Ji ruminated on the implications of these words, candidates flashing through his mind at lightning speed. Old Sect Master Ling Yuan? Han Lie? Or perhaps... Su Qingyao? No, Su Qingyao had no motive for faking death. That left only one possibility: someone was using the fake death scheme to position themselves, and this person was very likely the always-hidden Chen Tianming. His gaze suddenly darkened.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged, tinged with unusual urgency: "Little friend, the spatiotemporal rift will not hold much longer. If you want to know more, ask now. But remember, you only have one chance." Chen Ji drew a deep breath, gazing at the figure slowly dissolving in the rift: "One last question—why tell me all this? What do you have to gain?" The figure in the rift let out a knowing laugh: "Because you and I share a common enemy: the Heavenly Dao's Eye."

text.content: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye—" Chen Ji felt an electric current race up his spine. Mo Xiansheng had mentioned this entity before, a celestial will that towered above all, with countless seers having been its pawns. He had always thought it was merely legend, but now, everything seemed far more terrifying than he could have imagined. The rift began to contract sharply, the figure's voice growing increasingly distant: "Remember, the moment of the Dragon Vein awakening is your only chance to fake death. But before that, you must first survive this night."

choice.prompt: The mysterious being's warning still echoed in his ears—"survive this night." Forces from all sides of the Dragon Vein conflict had begun gathering at this location, and Chen Ji had to make a final decision: follow the original plan and wait for the right moment, or take early action?

choices.text: Execute the fake death plan early
choices.description: Since someone else is also scheming, waiting would be foolish. Chen Ji decides to advance the fake death plan, executing his scheme amid the chaos of the Dragon Vein conflict, betting big.
choices.visible_cost: Greatly increased risk of plan exposure
choices.visible_reward: Seize the first move and take control amid the chaos
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient preparation may cause the fake death to fail

text.content: A gleam of ruthlessness flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. Since someone didn't want him to proceed methodically, he would do the opposite. He quickly adjusted his plan in his mind, moving up the faked death that was originally scheduled for three days later to now. In his Sleeve Void, the jade talisman inscribed with the words "Faked Death" began to warm slightly. He said quietly to Mo Xiansheng: "Activate the backup plan, move up the Dragon Vein detonation by two hours."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng froze for a moment, then let out a sigh: "Are you sure? The backup plan carries at least three times the risk of the original." A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "Risk? In my book, risk is always a tool to outmaneuver enemies. Three times? So be it. I bet they're more panicked than I am."

choices.text: Wait according to the original plan
choices.description: Do not act rashly, observe the situation's development from the shadows. If someone fakes their death early, this provides an opportunity to observe their methods and gain reference for one's own plans.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the initiative, observe the opponent's movements
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may seize the initiative to disrupt the layout

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, suppressing the restlessness in his heart. A true hunter never dances to the rhythm set by their prey. He stepped back, his form merging into the surrounding shadows. The jade talisman in his Sleeve Void fell silent for now, but could be activated at any moment. His voice was cold as ice: "Let the bullet fly a bit longer. I want to see who breaks first."

dialogue.content: A note of approval sounded in Mo Xiansheng's voice: "Good composure. Not being led by the nose by your opponent—this is the temperament of one destined to become a chess master." Chen Ji did not respond, merely gazing quietly in the direction where the space-time rift had completely dissipated. In the distance, the spirit ships of various major sects had begun to gather, and the grand drama of the Dragon Vein contention was about to unfold. And he would play a role in this grand performance that no one saw coming.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji made his decision, the ground beneath his feet trembled again. But this time it wasn't a rift—it was a pulse from the Dragon Vein deep below, a premonition of some ancient and violent force awakening. Mo Xiansheng's voice tensed abruptly: "Trouble! Someone triggered the Dragon Vein ahead of time!" Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly—he hadn't expected them to act so quickly. In the distant sky, a golden pillar of light shot upward, intermingled with dragon roars, piercing the clouds. The space-time rift began expanding visibly, as if some primordial beast was trying to tear apart this world.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, gazing at the soaring golden pillar of light. A meaningful smile curved his lips: "Interesting. Seems I'm not the only one trying to fish in troubled waters." His right hand quietly slipped into his sleeve, grasping the jade talisman that could activate the faked death effect at any moment. Mo Xiansheng urged urgently: "Young friend, opportunity waits for no one—you must decide now!" Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze sweeping across the chaotic battlefield, and murmured: "Hold on, let me think... Since the Dragon Vein has been triggered ahead of schedule, everyone's attention will be drawn to it. This is actually my best opportunity."

text.content: In the distant sky, the experts from various major sects manifested one by one. Su Qingyao of the Tianqing Sect stood suspended in mid-air, her cold eyes scanning the entire scene; Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect was wrapped in flame-like blood and qi energy, rushing toward the Dragon Vein's core; Ye Qing of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path was shrouded in black mist, obscuring her expression. Chen Ji observed everything with keen eyes, rapidly calculating each move in his mind. His plan had been disrupted, but this also meant—everyone else's plans had been disrupted too. In this rare chaos, he instead saw an unprecedented opportunity.

Just then, a sharp sword light slashed from the side, directly targeting Chen Ji's vitals! It was an elder from the Tianqing Sect, clearly acting on secret orders from the old sect master Ling Yuan. Chen Ji retreated sharply while the jade talisman in his hand shattered with a thunderous crack. A layer of golden light enveloped his entire body, and the moment before the sword light touched him, his presence vanished completely, as if he had never existed. "Faked Death"—he activated it ahead of schedule!

But in the final moment before consciousness faded, Chen Ji witnessed a scene that chilled him to the bone—at the core of the Dragon Vein's eruption, another figure also turned to nothingness at the same instant. It was a figure he knew all too well, the one who had left behind a remnant soul at the Chen family ancestral lands: Mo Xiansheng's true self, Chen Xuan! He wasn't dead—he had been waiting for this moment all along! Within the space-time rift, countless threads of karma intertwined and wove together, and Chen Ji felt as though his fate was being nudged by an invisible hand, sliding toward the unknown.

Just as the Dragon Vein contention reached its peak intensity, a deafening dragon roar erupted from the depths of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, reverberating through heaven and earth. Chen Ji sensed the space-time rift beneath his feet beginning to expand wildly at a visible speed, with countless fragments of stars cascading down like a waterfall within the ethereal blue light. An unprecedented sense of oppression enveloped his entire being, as if the entire world was trembling at this very moment. He knew that the true trial had only just begun.
